newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Steel affiliate gets $50M loans.
newsitem.headline: China Steel affiliate gets $50M loans.

text.p: Taiwan's Taisil Electronic Materials Corp, an affiliate of China Steel, has obtained US$50 million in syndicated loans, a bank statement said on Monday.

The five-year loans would be used to finance the procurement of equipment and machinery for Taisil's second phase expansion of its plant in Hsinchu Science-Based Industrial Park, the ABN AMRO Bank's statement said.

The participating banks include ABN AMRO Bank, the International Commercial Bank of China, Taisin International Bank, Credit Lyonnais, the Shanghai Commercial & Savings Bank, and the Tokai Bank, it said.

Taisil, 35 percent owned by China Steel and 45 percent by MEMC Electronic Materials, is Taiwan's first producer of eight-inch silicon wafers to be used as raw materials for local IC makers' fabrication factories.
